meta.title: Publishing an RFP that ends after its RFQ is refused with 712
gaps: The plan does not verify that no stage was modified before the rejection.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with a technical (RFP) round and a pricing (RFQ) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer sends the request that updates (and publishes) the event, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
As the buyer, read the event and check that “status” equals draft.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “RFP duration exceeds RFQ end time. Please adjust.”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: “status” equals draft.
